{{Quote|I've got a better idea. Get in.|Vestara Khai, speaking to Ben Skywalker as she steals an AirCushion|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
The '''Ubrikkian AirCushion''' was a commonly used type of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Corocus]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]] in [[44 ABY]]. [[Vestara Khai]] appropriated a [[Color/Legends|turquoise-blue]] AirCushion alongside [[Ben Skywalker]] at Corocus' [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].
